items.html: And they begin beneath the entire aspect of the skull, below the two corners [of the head], which are at the two temples of the forehead, close to the ears. And below them, attached to them literally, the beard begins from the two sides of the face, beneath the corners [of the head], attached to them; and this is the narrow part of the beard, and it is not as wide as below. And these two sides are called the first correction of the beard; and although it is divided into two sides, the whole is but the aspect of correction 1. Just as the corners of the head on its two sides are wholly the aspect of the aforementioned Malchut of the Galgalta, so all that narrow [part] is correction 1, down to the place where the beard begins to widen, which is at the place of the beginning of the standing corners of the lower jaw, from where the beard begins to widen.
